privacy.title: Personal data processing policy
privacy.trainingNote: Training project: the operator and its details are fictitious; enter test data only.
privacy.operatorText: Operator: {name}, taxpayer no. {unp}, address: {address}. Contacts for requests: {email}, {phone}. The details are placeholders used to demonstrate the interface.
privacy.purposesTitle: Purposes, personal data and legal basis
privacy.purposesLead: Data is processed only for the purposes listed. Each purpose states the data, the basis and the term.
privacy.purposeAccountData: Email, first and last name, date of birth, optional sex and phone, password (stored only as a hash), time and version of the consent text.
privacy.purposeAccountBasis: The data subject consent (art. 5 of Law 99-Z), given by a mark on the site; the checkbox is never pre-filled.
privacy.purposeBookingData: Chosen doctor, service and time, booking status, cancellation reason as a code from a list (no free text). The fact of seeking medical care is covered by medical confidentiality.
privacy.purposeBookingBasis: Consent (art. 5) and actions under a contract being concluded for services (art. 6); the fact of seeking care falls under art. 8 para. 2 of Law 99-Z and is handled by clinic staff bound by medical confidentiality.
privacy.purposeClinicData: Health data entered by the doctor: visit data, diagnoses, prescriptions.
privacy.purposeClinicBasis: Special personal data: art. 8 para. 2 of Law 99-Z and art. 44 (part 13) of the Law on Healthcare. Consent to entering data into the clinic information system is given on paper at the clinic, not by a mark on the site.
privacy.purposeSecurityData: Time and type of the event (sign-in, failed sign-in, sign-out, actions on data), account identifier. IP address and browser details are not recorded.
privacy.purposeSecurityBasis: The operator duty to take protection measures (art. 17 of Law 99-Z).
privacy.retentionConsent: Consent is valid until withdrawn. The data of a closed account is kept for the period set by the operator under its records schedule (to be confirmed), after which the operator decides what to do with it. Medical records are not affected.
privacy.cookiesLead: Only technical cookies are used, without which sign-in and the site cannot work. There is no analytics, advertising or third-party service, so no consent banner is shown.
privacy.cookieAsSessionPurpose: Sign-in session at the authorization server after your login and password are checked, until you return to the app (HttpOnly)
privacy.cookieAsCsrfPurpose: Protection of the sign-in form against request forgery (HttpOnly)
privacy.cookieSessionPurpose: Marker that a session exists, for page navigation (HttpOnly)
privacy.cookiesStorage: Besides cookies, the browser keeps technical data the site needs to work. It stays in your browser and is not passed to third parties: the theme and language, the time of last activity "mc-last-activity" (for sign-out on inactivity, shared by all tabs), the booking draft (until the tab is closed), hidden hints in the patient profile, marks of started encounters (the last 50), the doctor's drafts (up to 3 days), the name of the patient an administrator has open (until the tab is closed) and a short notice about why you were signed out (until the next page).
privacy.rightsLead: The rights are set out in art. 10–14 of Law 99-Z:
privacy.rightInfo: to get information on the processing of your data, answered within 5 working days;
privacy.rightChange: to require inaccurate data to be changed, within 15 days;
privacy.rightWithdraw: to withdraw consent, with processing stopped within 15 days;
privacy.rightDelete: to require deletion, within 15 days, unless there are other grounds to keep the data, for example healthcare legislation.
privacy.rightsHow: The application is sent to the operator in writing or as an electronic document with an electronic digital signature. The rights are not limited to the personal account: an application can be filed without an account.
privacy.consequencesText: Without consent to keep an account, registration and online booking are unavailable. Booking and visits at the clinic remain possible through the front desk.
privacy.crossBorderText: No cross-border transfer is carried out.

passwordChange.title: Password
passwordChange.sectionLead: Change your password if someone else may know it. You will have to sign in again afterwards.
passwordChange.lead: After the change you are signed out on every device and sign in with the new password.
passwordChange.newHint: At least 10 characters: lower and upper case Latin letters, a digit and a symbol

accountClosure.title: Delete account
accountClosure.lead: You can close your personal cabinet. Sign-in stops, while your medical records stay with the clinic.
accountClosure.removedText: Access to the personal cabinet, sign-in with email and password, and the current session. Your consent to the personal cabinet will be withdrawn.
accountClosure.keptText: Visit records, appointment history and paper consents stay with the clinic: they are kept as required by health-care law, for the period set by the operator's retention schedule. Medical records are not deleted.
accountClosure.rightsText: You can request information about how your data is processed with a written application to the clinic. More in the
accountClosure.passwordHint: Enter your password to confirm the deletion.
accountClosure.wrongPassword: The password is wrong or the account is already closed.
accountClosure.closedLead: Sign-in to the personal cabinet is closed, the session has ended and your consent to the personal cabinet is withdrawn.

myData.title: My data
myData.lead: A file with the details about you that you can already see in the cabinet, and the information about how they are processed under art. 11 p. 1 of Law No. 99-Z.
myData.saved: The file is saved to your downloads folder.
myData.failed: The file could not be prepared. Try again.
myData.infoLegalBasis: Provided under art. 11 p. 1 of the Law of the Republic of Belarus No. 99-Z "On personal data protection".
myData.infoOperatorNote: The operator is fictitious: the details are placeholders of a training project.
myData.infoRetention: Data of a closed account and medical records are kept according to the operator's records schedule (the period is to be confirmed by the operator).
myData.infoAuthorised: No authorised persons have been assigned to process data on the operator's behalf (training project).
myData.infoFullRequest: Full information about the processing can be requested by a written application to the operator (art. 14 of Law No. 99-Z); the operator answers within 5 working days.

visitPrint.title: Visit record
visitPrint.footer: Entered by: {doctor}, {datetime}. This document was generated by an information system and is not a medical document; the paper entry in the medical record has legal force.
